title: SkyrimNet Brothel
tagline: Run your own brothel: register workers, send customers to them or take customers yourself, and SkyrimNet's AI voices every offer and answer while OStim or SexLab plays the scene.
description:
SkyrimNet Brothel lets you turn any interior into a brothel, and you can run up to three of them at once. It works with OStim Standalone or SexLab, whichever you have; with both, you choose one in the MCM. You register workers, women or men (followers or anyone else, or all your followers at once), or let the brothel hire workers of its own, and customers walk up to them and make paid offers. SkyrimNet's AI writes and voices each offer and the worker's answer, the worker can accept or refuse, and the scene plays on a free bed.

You can also take customers yourself and answer them by picking AI-written lines in the dialogue menu, including which position you want, or buy a worker's company with your own gold. You can offer people work at your brothel too: anyone who owes nothing, who keeps what they earn and may quit after any customer, or, with IOU Ledger installed, anyone who owes money, whose share of their earnings pays off the debt. The choice system is built into the mod, so SkyrimNet Player Choices is not needed.

People from the brothel's town can walk over during opening hours and become customers, and you can choose whether customers are men, women or both. Workers and customers who know each other, such as friends, lovers or regulars, talk like it, and relatives never do business together. You can name yourself or an NPC as the owner, who takes a share of every payment, recommends workers to customers and talks to the workers about their takings. Experienced workers invite customers on their own, workers chat among themselves between customers, and the brothel and every worker gain levels from 1 to 10 that change how they feel about the work.

Customers pay up front and get their gold back if the deal falls through. Everything is set up in an MCM with six pages, and a Manage Brothel power opens a menu with the main settings while you play. The mod requires OStim Standalone or SexLab P+ (SexLab 1.6x is supported but has not been tested in game), MCM Helper, PapyrusUtil and powerofthree's Papyrus Extender, and UIExtensions is needed only for the Manage Brothel power. Scouting people in debt needs IOU Ledger, which comes with SkyrimNet Slave Auction 0.2.0; without it that feature stays off. A Japanese translation is available as a separate archive.
author: taka
changelog:
- **Several brothels: no more customers left behind or missing.** Walking into another of your brothels could run the switch twice at the same time. Customers then appeared that no brothel kept track of: they stayed after the brothel was closed, and customers you added in the MCM could end up outside the brothel or not appear. Switching, adding and closing brothels and filling the customers and hired workers now run strictly one after another.
- **Leftover customers are removed** near you when a save loads, when customers are filled and when the last brothel is closed. If some remain where a brothel used to be, save and load there once.
- **Scouted workers come back.** A scouted worker found outside every brothel (another mod or their own day took them away, or their brothel was closed) is sent back to the brothel they work at.
- **A refund is paid once.** When a deal fell through as you walked into another brothel, the worker could give the gold back twice.
- The "pairs at once" limit message no longer shows when a picked worker was simply taken by another customer; it reads "no free worker".
- The plugin is unchanged from 0.4.4.
